title: Monotonic stack: next warmer day
summary: Days until a warmer temperature, or 0. The stack keeps unresolved days with non-increasing temperatures; a warmer day pops and answers them. Pops only on '<', so equal days keep waiting. O(n).
code: # Resolve earlier days when a warmer temperature arrives.
triggers: next greater or next smaller element for every position
'how many days until', 'first taller to the right'
prompts: For each day's share price, report how many days pass until a strictly higher price, or 0 if none comes.
People stand in a queue facing forward. For each person, how many places ahead is the first taller person?
invariant: stack holds the days still waiting for a warmer day, temperatures non-increasing from bottom to top.
mantra: A warmer day pops and answers every colder day below it.
pitfalls: Store indices, not temperatures: the answer is a distance.
'<' answers strictly warmer; '<=' also resolves equal days (next greater-or-equal).
Days still on the stack at the end keep their default 0.

anchors.name: Next Greater Element II
anchors.trick: Circular: loop over 2n indices with i % n and push only in the first pass.

anchors.name: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
anchors.trick: Increasing stack; pop on a shorter bar, width = i - stack[-1] - 1.

mutations.explanation: An equal temperature now counts as warmer: this answers next greater-or-equal.
Stores the warmer day's index instead of the distance to it.
